days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 135 ? push day was not logged again this week. Zero logs. That is two consecutive weeks with no push day data. Last confirmed session is still Aug 27: 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9. The weight does not move until I see the work. Touch the chest, pause a full second, drive through the heels, stay braced. Take all 90 seconds of rest. Log this Monday. This is not optional.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? push day not logged this week or last week. Last confirmed data: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. You were close to earning 50 but effort was still too high. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45, 2-second negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. Log it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? push day not logged. Still no confirmed session at 35 lbs. You were bumped up two weeks ago and I still have not seen a single set at this weight. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7. Log every set. This is still a baseline session.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? push day not logged. Last confirmed: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Stuck at the bottom of the rep range with too-high effort. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative. Stop swinging the weight up. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 20.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 95 ? push day not logged for two straight weeks. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8 from three weeks ago. Sets 2 and 3 were still at RPE 8. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked, lower to the chest, full lockout every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 across all three to earn 100.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out tricep rope pushdown from last week and bringing in the overhead extension. No baseline exists for this one ? push day has not been logged in two weeks so we never got the rope pushdown data either. Single dumbbell, both hands, elbows pointing up, lower behind the head, full extension at the top. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? pull day was not logged this week. Last confirmed: 10/8/8 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 1 was solid but sets 2 and 3 dropped in reps and climbed in effort. I need all three sets at 8+ reps with RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Take the full 2 minutes. Log every set.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? pull day not logged this week. Last confirmed data is 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. Log all three sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? pull day not logged this week. Last confirmed: you logged 50 lbs (lighter than the prescribed 55) at 10/10/10 RPE 7/8/8. The prescription has been 55 and stays at 55. One hand on the bench, pull to your hip, full squeeze at the top for one second, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is an issue. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? pull day not logged this week. Last confirmed: 12/12/12 at RPE 8/8/8. In the rep range but effort is too high. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? pull day not logged this week. Last confirmed: 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/8. Sets 1 and 2 were clean at RPE 7, set 3 crept to 8. You are very close. Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swinging, full curl, controlled negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 across all three to earn 35.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? bringing EZ bar curl back after rotating it out last week for the straight-arm pulldown. Pull day was not logged last week so no baseline was established for straight-arm pulldown ? we will revisit that one in the next pull rotation. EZ bar, strict form, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to the top, controlled negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? legs was not logged this week. Last confirmed: 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Same result as the week before. You are stuck. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. Push the rep count this week.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 155 ? legs not logged this week. Last confirmed: 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Set 1 was strong but sets 2 and 3 fell off. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, do not let the lower back round. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? legs not logged this week. Last confirmed: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? every single session at this weight has been the same result. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin vertical, drive through the front heel. You have more in you ? stop racking it at 10. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 35.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 85 ? legs not logged this week. Last confirmed: 12/12/12 at RPE 7/7/8. Sets 1 and 2 were excellent, set 3 crept to RPE 8. You were one tighter session away from 90. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 across all three ? set 3 is the one to nail.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? legs not logged this week. Last confirmed: only Set 1 was logged (15 reps at RPE 7) ? sets 2 and 3 were missing. One set is not a session. Complete and log all three sets this week. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled return ? no jerking. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out ab wheel rollout, which has had no baseline established across two weeks of logged legs sessions. We will come back to it. Hang from the pull-up bar on the rack, raise legs to parallel or higher, control the descent ? do not swing. Keep the movement slow and deliberate. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7 across all three sets. Log all three ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
